title: Design System: OvaLens Edge operator interface

extensions.nativeToolkit: CustomTkinter with native ttk selectors; no HTML/CSS component renderer.

focus.button: Tab traversal with {colors.focus} CTk border at 2px, restored on blur. No Canvas highlight rectangle. Enter and Space invoke with disabled guards; Space is consumed.
focus.entry: Use {colors.focus}; retain validation feedback on blur.
focus.scroll: Reveal the focused control within its scrollable form without changing the active section.
focus.checkbox: Tab traversal with visible CTk border; Space and Enter toggle with disabled guards.

extensions.elevation: Flat tonal surfaces and thin borders; no decorative shadows.

navigation.behavior: Persistent left section navigation beside one scrollable task form. Driver readback scrolls with the Camera fields.

dialogs.largeMinimumWidth: 880px for requested widths of at least 900px, workspace-clamped
dialogs.behavior: Scrollable forms above fixed actions; run quantity pinned with setup actions; STOP in guide, history, end-session, exit and settings; Escape invokes native close guards.

flow.safety: Preserve background I/O and single camera stream
flow.header: Settings directly in header; More for diagnostics
flow.ready: Heading follows actual batch/operator/preparation state; footer shows the same three-step next action

components.name: Station settings field
components.description: Aligned native entry with a readable control border and {colors.focus} keyboard focus; scrolls within its task form.

components.name: Settings navigation
components.description: Persistent task list with quiet selected surface and {colors.brand-text} selected text. Maintenance groups physical tests and alignment.

components.name: Fixed settings actions
components.description: Apply for this run, Save defaults, Load saved, Done and STOP remain reachable outside the scrollable task form. Applying and remembering defaults remain distinct.

components.name: Camera workspace
components.description: Dark camera well with separate light text and cycle instructions above the preview. Give available workspace width to the image.

components.name: Record panel
components.description: Compact dim slate panel grouping the latest result, aligned counts and recent events with spacing and thin dividers.

components.name: Native selector
components.description: Read-only ttk selector with neutral field, light values and arrow, {colors.focus} border and an eight-row scrolling popup. Programmatic changes do not invoke user callbacks.

narrative.overview: Mode: Operate. Low-glare dim slate surfaces, a larger camera workspace and task-grouped settings support native station operation. The operator must see the egg, understand a stopped conveyor and act safely. This user-approved correction preserves existing operating and safety guidance.
dos: **Do** keep camera evidence, cycle instructions and STOP visible at the minimum workspace size.
**Do** group configuration by operator task and place physical station tests in Maintenance.
**Do** pair status colors with explicit text and keep driver readback reachable by scrolling.
donts: **Don't** equate preview, saved defaults or an unconfirmed hardware request with physical readiness.
**Don't** add decorative timers, image assets, shadows or additional camera streams.
